about: #4628: mutation testing of each det port (tests/tools/mutation.py on `det_port.py run --translate-only`'s port, fast mode, seeded sample), written only by tests/tools/det_mutation.py. An entry is trusted only while its fingerprints match the tree; stale or missing is unknown. Survivors are accounted for in det_mutation_survivors/ (reviewed).
